# pds2img

> NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) to Image conversion library.

## Guide

- [Introduction](/pds2img/guide/start/introduction.md): What pds2img is, which NASA PDS products it reads, and how the conversion works.
- [Getting started](/pds2img/guide/start/getting-started.md): Install pds2img and convert a PDS3 or PDS4 product to PNG in a few lines.
- [In the browser](/pds2img/guide/usage/browser.md): Use pds2img in the browser with URLs, file inputs, the File System Access API, image previews and downloads.
- [In Node.js](/pds2img/guide/usage/node.md): Use pds2img in Node.js with Buffers, attached PDS3 labels and batch conversion.
- [Command line](/pds2img/guide/usage/cli.md): Convert PDS3 and PDS4 products to PNG or TIFF from the command line with the pds2img CLI.
- [Supported formats](/pds2img/guide/usage/formats.md): PDS3 label keywords, PDS4 elements and sample data types supported by pds2img.

## API

- [API Overview](/pds2img/api/index.md): Overview of every function, class and type exported by pds2img.
- [Loaders](/pds2img/api/loaders.md): Reference for the pds2img loader functions for PDS3, PDS4 and directories.
- [Images](/pds2img/api/images.md): Reference for the PDSImage interface and the PDS3Image and PDS4Image classes.
- [Encoders](/pds2img/api/encoders.md): Reference for the pds2img PNG and TIFF encoders.
- [Parsers](/pds2img/api/parsers.md): Reference for the pds2img PDS3 LBL and PDS4 XML label parsers.
- [Types](/pds2img/api/types.md): Reference for the TypeScript types exported by pds2img.

## Playground

- [Playground](/pds2img/playground.md): Convert your own PDS3 or PDS4 files to PNG / TIFF in the browser.
